notes.title: Freedom Poopie new Patch features
notes.notes:
Hi there everyone!

Christmas is around the corner, and today we uploaded [b]a new patch with a lot of new features[/b], including:

[list]
    [*] A brand new skin, Poopie Claus!
    [*] New Trading Cards system
    [*] 32 New achievements
    [*] The majestic Seal of Approval
    [*] Three new languages: French, German and Catalan
    [*] New and more smooth menu interface
    [*] Of course, bug fixing and fps optimisation
    [*] We added some extra material as well, check it!
[/list]

Because we want to celebrate and share everything with the community, [b]we are launching a 15% discount[/b] only available for a few days! Don't miss it!

P.S. You will find the Freedom Poopie OST as a DLC to purchase at only 1,99€.

Thank you for all the support and please share with us your feedback, every opinion is important!

[b]Electroplasmatic Games[/b]
